title: Yield test: hollow_pilgrim at tanglewood_frost_ring (lawless); what a kill drops and whether a bid takes it
note: A test with one ship (orders.log ENT-011, block APOPHIS: every untested herd of prey of 100 hull or less with ten animals or more gets a test hunt; F9). No run of ours has looted this species. The herd read 11 at 2026-11-15 23:34 UTC, 70 hull (data/wildlife/). Beyond policed space (F13): `alone` and an empty hold. 2 kills a run, ranched: no hunt below 4 animals. Loot that no bid of 50 cr or more takes is stored at the station, so the row's goods show the drop; whether it is caustic sac (bid 420 cr at seven stations) is part of the question. Written by Apophis 2026-11-16 03:00 UTC; it leaves the plan after its first RESULT line unless the drop sells. 2026-11-22 00:08 UTC (Apophis): gift_to trader (queue.log ENT-200, ENT-201: strict classes, Suggi D244): with the switch on, the loot goes into the trader named for sell_at; off, nothing changes. Apophis 2026-11-24 10:32 UTC: min_bid 50 -> 5000, its loot holds creature_carapace, which the reserve lacks (short 873; reserve_hunts.py, rule F24): every drop is kept, none sold.
